notes.title: 2024.11.14 fix
notes.content:
After deciphering the Wordless Heavenly Book, the map will display the locations of items.
 Fixed a bug where the interface would crash after enhancing attributes six times.
 When playing with Steam Deck, the game will adapt to the native resolution.
 Adjusted the Tongtian Pillar map and fixed the issue with inaccurate positioning.
 Adjusted NPC dialogues to include more clues for completing the game.

notes.title: 2024.10.27 fix
notes.content:
Collecting paper money restores a small amount of health.
 Pause screen emphasizes the location of the Continue button.

notes.title: 2024.10.12 fix
notes.content:
Fixed the bug that triggered the dialogue when MengPo was resting.
